items.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
items.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

items.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada and says countries close to a deal
items.description: US President Donald Trump said he will delay imposing new tariffs on a wide array of Canadian goods for three days as the countries firm up a trade deal.

items.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
items.description: Meta argued social media addiction does not exist, as a trial stemming from a major lawsuit brought by US states started.

items.title: Witness gets combative in Tupac murder trial - 'I don't want to send him to prison'
items.description: The witness said he had little love for the man on trial for the rapper's murder, but refused to answer questions that he thought would send Duane "Keffe D" to prison.

items.title: Husband and mother-in-law charged over Indian bride's death
items.description: Twisha Sharma, a model and actor, had been married for just five months when she was found dead in May.

items.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
items.description: Environmentalists have heavily criticised the exploratory drilling in the sea off the mouth of the Amazon.

items.title: Iranian academic writes of US detention 'hell' over link to 1979 hostage crisis
items.description: The immigration status of Maryam Tahmasebi was revoked because her husband is the son of a prominent figure in Iran.

items.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
items.description: A statement on the blues-rock band's website said he died on Monday in hospice

items.title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
items.description: A number of buildings and cars are damaged in the historic city, and the world famous Alhambra palace has temporarily closed.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
items.description: Lindsay Clancy has admitted killing her daughter and two sons but has pleaded not guilty to murder, saying she was experiencing postpartum psychosis.

items.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
items.description: Imran Khan has been imprisoned since 2023 on corruption charges which he says were politically motivated.

items.title: US announces new sanctions on top ICC figures
items.description: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the international court "brick by brick".

items.title: Kariba ferry death toll rises to 93, making it Zimbabwe's deadliest transport disaster
items.description: Recovery efforts continue in what is the country's deadliest transport disaster.

items.title: Harvard agrees to pay millions after morgue manager sold body parts
items.description: Harvard Medical School has agreed to pay $53 million to families who alleged the school mishandled the donated remains of loved ones.

items.title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
items.description: While hailing Zhu’s legacy, authorities are wary that the nostalgia could lead to criticisms of Xi’s rule.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere's ex Wladimir Klitschko says family in 'profound shock and grief'
items.description: The former heavyweight boxing champion shares a child with the Heroes actress, who died on Sunday.

items.title: Judge swapped in Trump's defamation case against BBC
items.description: A judge who was recently nominated by the US president to serve in Florida's federal court will now preside over his $10bn defamation case against the BBC.

items.title: Nigeria influencer arrested after seizure of cocaine worth $28m destined for the UK
items.description: Afolabi Kazeem Micheal has not commented on allegations he is linked to a global drug trafficking network.

items.title: Disney and ABC sue Trump's media regulator to stop early licence renewal
items.description: The network accuses the administration of retaliating against ABC because it "disapproves of what ABC broadcasts".

items.title: Man in Chucky-style mask terrorises Philadelphia residents
items.description: "It was just weird, like some twisted game": At least half a dozen people were threatened near City Hall last week.
